deployedUpdates.value: UtsavOS turns a personalized AI plan into editable budgets, tasks and vendor requirements for weddings, birthdays and community events. Users review and selectively accept suggestions. Exact INR calculations and versioned PostgreSQL transactions power explainable guest-count changes: a 150-guest plan with ₹300,000 fixed expenses and ₹850 catering per guest totals ₹427,500;180 guests total ₹453,000 with ₹47,000 remaining from ₹500,000. Changes save only after approval. Authentication, tenant isolation, persistence, audit history and mobile workflows are tested. Guests/RSVP, delegated teams, financial records, private source-reviewed documents, workspace limits and eligible data export/deletion are implemented behind rollout flags. No real vendor booking or payment execution is claimed.
